title.en: Add timed deep-learning sessions to multilingual QA
title.zh: 为多语言真实 QA 增加随机深度学习时段

purpose.en: Make every 03:00 real-user QA run actively learn each target language for a reproducible random 1–5 minute minimum and generate legitimate score evidence.
purpose.zh: 让每天凌晨 3 点的真实用户 QA 为每种目标语言执行可复现随机 1–5 分钟的最低有效学习，并生成真实分数证据。

en: Assign English, Japanese, Spanish, and Italian independent 1–5 minute minimum active-learning sessions each day.
Rotate a deep-focus skill while preserving full Course, Learn through play, and Everyday Speaking coverage.
Require a displayed server-graded score and persisted learning log for every target language.
zh: 每天分别为英语、日语、西班牙语和意大利语分配 1–5 分钟最低有效学习时段。
轮换一项深度学习重点，同时保留课程、边玩边学和生活口语的完整覆盖。
要求每种目标语言都有界面显示的服务器判分及持久学习日志。
凌晨 3 点真实用户 QA 计划
管理员 Project QA 报告

en: Generate a deterministic daily session plan whose random minute assignments remain stable during same-day retries.
Count only active feedback-producing learning actions; exclude login, navigation, loading, idle waits, repairs, and deployment time.
Record planned versus measured minutes, deep-focus activity, displayed score, and persisted score-log evidence in Project.
zh: 生成确定性的每日学习计划，使随机分钟数在同日重试时保持一致。
只计算会产生反馈的真实学习操作；登录、导航、加载、空等、修复与部署时间均不计入。
在 Project 记录计划/实测分钟、深度重点、界面分数及持久分数日志证据。

en: Behavior tests prove every daily duration is between one and five minutes, same-day plans are reproducible, and all five duration values occur across the campaign.
The route preflight exposes the required real-session plan but remains explicitly barred from claiming login, score, or learning evidence.
The real-user prompt forbids passive waiting and synthetic score rows while retaining all four languages and all required learning surfaces.
zh: 行为测试证明每日时长均为 1–5 分钟，同日计划可复现，且整个周期覆盖全部五种分钟值。
路线预检会输出真实会话计划，但明确不能声称已经登录、判分或完成学习。
真实用户提示禁止被动等待和伪造分数记录，同时保留四种语言及全部学习区域。

en: The next scheduled real-user execution supplies the first measured timed-session score evidence; this release validates and deploys the automation contract itself.
zh: 下一次定时真实用户执行将产生首份计时学习分数证据；本次发布验证并部署自动化契约本身。

en: This automation update is SmartLingo-only and does not alter learning data or schedules on other portfolio sites.
zh: 本自动化更新仅适用于 SmartLingo，不改变其他站点的学习数据或计划。
